semantics_limitations.hard_reject: Local cnn_core.background_reject remains inherited constant zero, verified in current r5 source. Forced hard-reject publication tests do not prove learned background rejection.
semantics_limitations.explicit_type11: Authenticated explicit Type11 reason0x80 does not compare packet frame ID to accepted task ID. Ordinary transport Type11/network changes preserve accepted writing jobs. This baseline limitation is unchanged.
semantics_limitations.independent_data: 642 development frames and synthetic controls establish reference parity; no independent capture accuracy is asserted.
semantics_limitations.latency: PCB fullpipeline10.205..10.484ms uses abstract2..4cycle reader, not actual DDR/mainboard timeout. Ordinary ROI is1880088cycles before localization/link overhead.
semantics_limitations.reader: Reader/store uses controlled8ns/14ns clocks and behavioral app responses; source-extracted routing is read-side only, not full top/HXA FSM or vendor DDR/PHY.
semantics_limitations.cnn_edges: Raw core reset and idle workspace/MAC ownership reuse; no complete top safety authorization is inferred.
semantics_limitations.hardware: Board placement/pose generalization, physical writing, disconnect and reset acceptance remain NOT_RUN.
